results.name: Hue Citadel
results.description: Hoàng thành được xây dựng năm 1804, nhưng mãi đến năm 1833 đời vua Minh Mạng mới hoàn chỉnh toàn bộ hệ thống cung điện với khoảng 147 công trình.Hoàng thành có mặt bằng gần vuông, mỗi bề khoảng 600 mét, xây bằng gạch, cao 4m, dày 1m, xung quanh có hào bảo vệ, có 4 cửa để ra vào: Cửa chính (phía Nam) là Ngọ Môn, phía Đông có cửa Hiển Nhơn, phía Tây có cửa Chương Đức, phía Bắc có cửa Hòa Bình. Các cầu và hồ được đào chung quanh phía ngoài thành đều có tên Kim Thủy.Hoàng thành và toàn bộ hệ thống cung điện bên trong được bố trí trên một trục đối xứng, trong đó trục chính giữa được bố trí các công trình chỉ dành cho vua. Các công trình ở hai bên được phân bố chặt chẽ theo từng khu vực, tuân thủ nguyên tắc (tính từ trong ra): "tả nam hữu nữ", "tả văn hữu võ". Ngay cả trong các miếu thờ cũng có sự sắp xếp theo thứ tự "tả chiêu hữu mục" (bên trái trước, bên phải sau, lần lượt theo thời gian).

results.name: Archangel Citadel UPDATED
results.description: This is the hub in my game Quest Of Raziya! I spent about 5 and a half months or so overhauling this badboy. I completely redid the town inside the citadel to be more like a typical start-of-your-adventure RPG town rather than the hastily thrown together city from the old version, using Sprytile to speed up the process. I redrew half the textures and repainted the others. I redid the topology to meet Sega Saturn standards by disolving half the edges making everything quadrilaterals instead of tris, I disolved and even deleted faces to meet PS1 N64 and Saturn limitations, and I recut all the textures to be 64 x 64, 128 x 64 or 64 x 128 to meet N64 limitations, all to make it look authentically mid 90's. Hell this baby can probably render ona  3DO or Jaguar if I wanted to porn Quest Of Raziya there! I have lost so much sleep working on this model just like I did when I made the original but now this specific weight is off my shoulders.

results.name: The Nine Holy Cannons - Hue Imperial City
results.description:
The Nine Holy Cannons - Hue Imperial | City Cửu Vị Thần Công - Di sản Cố đô Huế

A detailed 3D reconstruction of the Nine Holy Cannons – national treasures of the Hue Imperial City. Cast in 1803 during Emperor Gia Long's reign, these nine cannons symbolize the protection of the kingdom. They are divided into two groups: The Four Seasons (Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter) and The Five Elements (Metal, Wood, Water, Fire, Earth). Each cannon is a masterpiece of bronze craftsmanship with intricate dragon motifs and Han characters. Perfect for digital heritage, military history, and architectural visualization.

Mô hình 3D phục dựng Cửu Vị Thần Công – bảo vật quốc gia đặt tại Hoàng thành Huế. Được đúc năm 1803 dưới thời vua Gia Long, chín khẩu súng mang ý nghĩa bảo vệ vương triều, chia làm 2 nhóm: Tứ Thời (Xuân, Hạ, Thu, Đông) và Ngũ Hành (Kim, Mộc, Thủy, Hỏa, Thổ). Mỗi khẩu súng là một tác phẩm nghệ thuật điêu khắc đồng tinh xảo với các họa tiết rồng mây và chạm khắc chữ Hán tỉ mỉ.

results.name: Machu Picchu - Peru, Andes Mountains
results.description: Machu Picchu is an Incan citadel set high in the Andes Mountains in Peru, above the Urubamba River valley. It was built in the 15th century by the Inca empire and later abandoned. It is renowned for its sophisticated dry-stone walls that fuse huge blocks without the use of mortar.  Many intriguing buildings of archaeology are on astronomical alignments and yield stunning panoramic views. Its exact former use remains a mystery.  -Nate Loper

results.name: Ja'bar Citadel in Syria
results.description:
Qalaat Ja’bar, or Jabbar Castle, is one of the most important medieval castles in Syria, particularly in the north. This sprawling anti-Crusader fortress of the eleventh century dominates an escarpment overlooking the east or left bank of the Euphrates River in Raqqa Province, 17 km northwest of the city of Al-Thawra. The castle is 55 km from Raqqa city and 45 km east of the City of Meskana, at an elevation of 347 km above sea level. Today the site lies on the edge of the impound lake behind the Tabqa hydroelectric dam, which was completed in the 1970s. 

General description of Ja’bar  Castle:
The castle is 320 m × 170 m and is enclosed by two huge walls surrounding the castle's facilities. In the center of the castle a mosque was built, and its minaret is still majestic after it was restored. The castle is located at the following coordinates: 35°53'48.80"N38°28'52.09"E
The castle, which looks like an island in the middle of Lake Assad, is connected to the mainland by a small road.

results.name: Remnant of the Medieval Santa Fiora Drawbridge
results.description:
From 1381 to 1385 Santa Fiora, for most of its history an independent medieval state ruled by Counts Aldobrandeschi, was conquered by the Republic of Siena, which transformed it into a military hub in Monte Amiata. The Siennese government started an intense construction activity of fortification and extension of the former Aldobrandeschi fortress. The first intervention consisted in the expansion of the defensive moat that ran at least on the south and east sides of the citadel wall and part of which is still preserved and visible in the basement of the surveyed structures. At the same time, a fortified antiport was built, which housed the main entrance to the fortress proper, through a drawbridge crossing the moat. 

Faro Scans 36, Images 1507

Michele Nucciotti, 1998, “Note sulla politica urbanistica del governo senese di Santa Fiora (1381-1385)”, in Tracce…
Michele Nucciotti, Guido Vannini, 2002, “Santa Fiora: strutture materiali di una capitale rurale nella Toscana meridionale del Medioevo”, Siena.

results.name: Сavernous stone of Sacsayhuaman | Peru
results.description:
[Google map](https://maps.app.goo.gl/S8YZvoYwFFvG2D8L8)

Sacsayhuamán is a citadel on the northern outskirts of the city of Cusco, Peru, the historic capital of the Inca Empire. The site is at an altitude of 3,701 m (12,142 ft).
The complex was built by the Incas in the 15th century, particularly under Sapa Inca Pachacuti and his successors. Dry stone walls constructed of huge stones were built on the site, with the workers carefully cutting the boulders to fit them together tightly without mortar.

[Artifacts of Peru COLLECTION](https://sketchfab.com/3dsploshnoff/collections/peru-3d-sploshnoff)

Photogrammetry model by Alexander Sploshnov @3dsploshnoff.
The shooting was carried out by a researcher from the laboratory of alternative history - Evgeniy Dolgiy.

results.name: Cyberpunks HQ [Greybox] | Decentraland
results.description:
**Greybox model of the Cyber Citadel, the home of the Cyberpunks in Angzaar** - one part of a larger whole for the community of Decentraland, designed and produced as a part of the Last Slice Collective. This model is intended for game use, but is WIP, so materials and meshes are not complete nor fully optimial. That said, this is already a highly-efficient low-poly city being just over 300K tris in totality.

Greybox design, modeling, rigging, and animations done by Archonomous. Graffiti art is community-provided.

Angzaar Outpost is a condensed MMORPG-style project that aims to bring all of the exisiting Player marketplace infrastructure of the pertpetually-online Web3 world of Decentraland into the game world as an immersive experience, while simultaneously adding gamifications & helpful resources to a centric Hub. This asset represents one part of a much larger whole.
